strategy.title: Look Away for 1 Second—Your Brain Rebuilds the Scene
strategy.hook: When attention breaks, the brain fills the missing moment with its best prediction rather than a faithful recording.

story_structure.opening: Show three apparently unrelated scenes where the brain's attention system appears.
story_structure.escalation: Overlay the shared pattern so the connection becomes visually undeniable.
story_structure.takeaway: Give viewers one observation prompt they can use to spot the pattern themselves.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Three everyday vignettes linked by one repeating geometry for the brain's attention system; subtle-to-bright pattern reveal, unified color cue, discovery-focused composition
